name: AWS Cloud Credits for Open Source

whatYouGet.zh-Hant: AWS 促銷點數，常用於上游與效能測試、CI/CD、存放建置產物
whatYouGet.zh-Hans: AWS 促销点数，常用于上游与性能测试、CI/CD、存放构建产物
whatYouGet.en: AWS promotional credits, typically used for upstream and performance testing, CI/CD and artifact storage

whyItHelps.zh-Hant: 用雲端點數支付 CI 跑者、效能測試環境與檔案儲存，把經費留給專案本身。
whyItHelps.zh-Hans: 用云点数支付 CI 运行器、性能测试环境与文件存储，把经费留给项目本身。
whyItHelps.en: Cover CI runners, performance test environments and storage with credits, keeping funds for the project itself.

requirements.zh-Hant: 一般需採 OSI 認可授權（領域內常用的非 OSI 授權也可申請）；填寫申請表寄到 awsopensourcecredits@amazon.com，每月審核發放
requirements.zh-Hans: 一般需采用 OSI 认可的许可证（领域内常用的非 OSI 许可证也可申请）；填写申请表发送到 awsopensourcecredits@amazon.com，每月审核发放
requirements.en: Generally an OSI-approved license (projects using common non-OSI licenses in their space may still apply); email the application form to awsopensourcecredits@amazon.com; reviewed and issued monthly
